subject.title: fix(ui): preserve active Workboard sessions when editing cards

question: Should this PR require an isolated disposable Gateway-to-Workboard-store persistence run before merge, rather than accepting the mocked Chromium Gateway assertion plus plugin-store tests as sufficient proof?
rationale: The code path changes session state at a boundary where an empty value intentionally deletes the link, while the supplied browser proof intercepts that boundary with a mock.

options.title: Require isolated persistence proof
options.body: Require a redacted disposable Workboard setup that edits an execution-owned card and shows the persisted session key remains intact after the real update path.

options.title: Accept the current layered tests
options.body: Accept the mocked Chromium request assertion and real plugin-store test suite as sufficient evidence for this narrowly scoped UI initialization change.

recommendation.title: Require isolated persistence proof
recommendation.body: Require a redacted disposable Workboard setup that edits an execution-owned card and shows the persisted session key remains intact after the real update path.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete supplied the reproduction, focused patch, and current evidence narrative, so they are the available contact for completing the requested proof.
